claim_boundary: G13 selects equilibrium Seebeck coefficient as the strongest fourth-channel acquisition target. No candidate is fit-ready, no fourth response surface is admitted, and no graphene Pluecker residual or significance is computed.
decisive_reasons: Equilibrium Seebeck coefficient is the strongest directly measured and conceptually independent fourth-response candidate.
The primary Wang-Shi source reports broad temperature and carrier-density coverage, but public machine-readable arrays and covariance are not verified.
The Zuev-Kim source provides clearly verified density sweeps at only 150 K and 200 K inside the 110-260 K sector, below the frozen three-temperature gate.

Quantum capacitance lacks a verified target-window temperature-density surface, Hall density duplicates a chart coordinate, and transient or Raman candidates fail sector or two-dimensional coverage gates.
required_author_data: pointwise measured Seebeck coefficient versus gate voltage or carrier density at each equilibrium temperature
temperature list and sample thermometer calibration
thermovoltage and temperature-gradient raw or fit-level data
gate-voltage to carrier-density calibration and uncertainty
pointwise statistical uncertainty and shared systematic covariance
device identifiers, sweep direction, contact geometry and annealing state
